text: The analysis shows that **0.5 hectares (about 2.84% of the 17.6-hectare property)** of native forest was lost on this property in 2022. This is confirmed by multiple sources: Hansen GFC detected 0.6 ha of tree-cover loss, while the Uruguayan MGAP forest map identified 0.5 ha of the lost area as native forest. The loss event was corroborated by the JRC 2020 reference data, which agreed that the area was forested in 2020. Additionally, 0.2 ha of smaller patches (<0.5 ha) were excluded from the main event count due to size thresholds. No planted forest was affected.
